revision: v5 (Fusion 360: MotorMount_v9 gearbox-bolted bracket + MotorClampStrap_v1; ball casters removed; motors rotated 180deg)
arrangement: motor inserted from gearbox/wheel side into tilted cradle; gearbox front face bolted to bracket wall plate via 4x M3 taps (PCD17); motor barrel clamped by strap; one-piece portal bracket reaches Frame_L1 underside

overlap_mm3.note: strap_motor はモーター冠部リブへの押さえ代(設計上のプリロード)。strap_bracket_seat はストラップ座面とレール上面の座り代(面一接触+局所、平均約0.04mm)。その他は全ペア 0 mm3、3ユニットとも同一結果

hole_alignment.gearbox_taps: motor front face M3 taps at PCD17 (±8.5,0)/(0,±8.5) local, Ø2.5 modeled
hole_alignment.wall_plate_holes: 4x Ø3.4 coaxial with taps (3.0 mm axial offset between cylinder origins only)
hole_alignment.pad_holes_vs_frame: 4x Ø4.5 at (57,±9)/(64,±9) mm match Frame_L1 Ø4.2 holes

clearance_mm.washer_room_gearbox_bolts: adjacent tap pitch 12 mm; flat face around Ø3.4 holes fits M3 washers
clearance_mm.note: 壁板はギアボックス前面とアダプタの間(約8 mm)にあり、ボルト頭+ワッシャーが収まる

frame_L1.type: M4 screw + nut (clearance holes both sides)
frame_L1.bracket_pad_holes: 4x Ø4.5 vertical at (57,±9) and (64,±9) mm, pad top flush with Frame_L1 bottom
frame_L1.frame_holes: 4x Ø4.2 at identical XY positions (verified on Frame_L1 solid)

gearbox_face.type: M3 bolts + washers through bracket wall plate into gearbox taps
gearbox_face.wall_plate_holes: 4x Ø3.4, coaxial with PCD17 tap pattern

clamp_strap.type: M3 screws into thermal insert nuts
clamp_strap.bracket_insert_pockets: 4x Ø4.6 on cradle block top faces
clamp_strap.strap_holes: 4x Ø3.4 through, coaxial with insert pockets

removed.ball_casters: Caster_Pololu_P0/P1/P2 occurrences and components deleted; holder exports removed

assumptions: パッド上面は Frame_L1 下面に面一で接し、M4 ネジ+ナットで締結
モーターはギアボックス側(ホイール側)の開口から挿入。エンコーダー・コネクタ非対称張り出しは開口側を向き非拘束
保持はギアボックスタップ締結+ストラップ締め付け。実機で抜け・ガタが出たら抜け止め形状を追加
ギアボックス前面タップの実寸(径・有効深さ)は実機採寸で確定する
